messages:
emma: Heads-up — ACME dedicated cluster scaled at 2025-09-12T09:12Z but the Dedicated dashboard shows 0 GPUs for that capacity pool. k8s nodes are Ready and the node agent reports GPUs present. Can someone triage? :eyes:

raj: looped in. Do we know if this is just the UI or the inventory service as well? Any recent deploys to inventory-sync or console?

emma: looks like inventory service last successful sync was ~09:05. We scaled up at 09:12. Quick curl to internal API shows stale data: ```curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" https://infra.internal/redwood/inventory?pool=acme | jq .gpus_total {
  "total": 0,
  "by_node": []
}```

sre-bot: ALERT inventory-sync: last_success=2025-09-12T09:05:18Z, lag=7m, pending_changes=1

maria: thanks — that suggests the sync worker didn't pick up the k8s event. Can you paste the controller logs from inventory-sync around 09:12? Any OOMs or backpressure?

emma: I can't grab logs from customer cluster, but infra control plane pod logs for inventory-sync show repeated transient 503s to cluster-manager at 09:11-09:13. Snippet: ```2025-09-12T09:11:57Z ERROR fetcher.go:142 getNodes: 503 ServiceUnavailable
2025-09-12T09:12:05Z WARN syncer.go:88 enqueue change: scale_event pool=acme count=8
2025-09-12T09:12:06Z INFO syncer.go:95 queued change id=672 status=pending
2025-09-12T09:12:07Z ERROR sender.go:67 postToConsole: timeout
```

kevin: we rolled a cluster-manager bump at 09:10 — maybe the bump caused the 503s briefly. Inventory-sync should retry but looks like it errored on final push to console cache. I'm going to trigger a backfill/sync job for change id=672: `/admin/inventory/force-sync?id=672`

raj: FYI the console caches inventory for 5m TTL; in most cases a forced sync fixes the UI within ~30s after the backfill completes.

kevin: kicked the job: `POST /admin/inventory/force-sync?id=672` => 202 Accepted job=backfill-672

sre-bot: JOB backfill-672: started by kevin at 2025-09-12T09:17:03Z

olivia: any impact to metrics/alerts? Customers reported latency spikes but not errors. Could be unrelated but want to flag.

maria: I deployed a small patch to make the final push to console more resilient (retry=5, exponential backoff). Will monitor.

sre-bot: JOB backfill-672: completed 2025-09-12T09:22:51Z status=success updated_pools=[acme]

emma: verified with ACME — dashboard shows 8 GPUs now, node list populated. Thanks team :thumbsup:

raj: closing on our side but leaving notes: root cause = transient 503 from cluster-manager during scale-up + no final-retry path on sender to console cache. Action items: 1) add stronger retry and metrics on failed console pushes (maria) 2) add monitoring alert for consecutive 503s from cluster-manager (kevin) 3) add customer-facing note to support runbook for forced backfill (emma/olivia).

maria: I'll open PR for retries and add a small gauge metric `inventory.sender.failures` so this is visible in Console.

emma: reopening if ACME sees anything else, otherwise closing thread. :white_check_mark:
